The home players have grown in confidence and started to string some passes together. The visiting side have relied on their defence and counter-attacks.

variations.commentary: the fans in the stadium certainly won't regret buying tickets as they witnessed a great game today. the home side dominated today's game. the home side are keeping possession of the ball with some short passes, while the visitors are waiting to open up their defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

we have been watching a lacklustre game with only a few moments to excite the crowd. the players surely have better abilities, they just needed to motivate themselves a little more. neither side has really focused on a well - organized defence.
